Memorandum on the movements of L. Guterman,
Suspect Soviet Agent

L. Guterman arrived in Shanghai from Tsingtao
on November 17, 1932 by the s.s. "Hoten Maru."
He is a Russian of Jewish origin and a merchant by
profession. He is strongly suspected by the Chinese
authorities in Tsingtao of being a Soviet Agent.
L. Guterman is a known dealer of Soviet goods
especially jewellery. His wife is a sister of
M.M. Shvetz a clerk employed at the local branch of
the Dalbank (Far Eastern Bank).
He resides at Apartment 20, 455 Rue Lafayette,
the residence of M. Shvetz.

Jtcheumshansky
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch

1932年11月19日

S.2. 1932年11月19日。

关于疑似苏联特工 L. 古特曼（L. Guterman）行踪的备忘录

L. 古特曼于1932年11月17日乘“Hoten Maru”号轮船从青岛抵达上海。
他是俄裔犹太人，职业为商人。他被青岛的中国当局强烈怀疑为苏联特工。
L. 古特曼是众所周知的苏联商品经销商，尤其是珠宝。他的妻子是 M.M. 施韦茨（Shvetz）的姐妹，施韦茨在远东银行（Dalbank）本地分行任职员。
他居住在霞飞路455号20室公寓，即 M. 施韦茨的住所。

Jtcheumshansky
D. S.

情报。

Dte 11 / 8 / 32

Special Branch S.2.
August 10, 1932.

Memorandum on movements of L. Guterman and A. Beerbrayer,
Suspected Soviet Agents

L. Guterman and A. Beerbrayer left Shanghai for
Tsingtao on August 5, 1932 by the s.s. "Dairen Maru".
They arrived in Shanghai on July 30, 1932 in connection
with the sale of a quantity of jewellery belonging to
Gostorg (Soviet State Trading Syndicate). During their
sojourn here they resided at A. Beerbrayer residence at
Route Grouchy, Pass. 9, House No.16 and according to
our information were unsuccessful in concluding any
transactions.

D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

关于疑似苏联特工 L. 古特曼（L. Guterman）和 A. 比尔布雷耶（A. Beerbrayer）行踪的备忘录

L. 古特曼和 A. 比尔布雷耶于1932年8月5日乘“大连丸”号轮船离开上海前往青岛。
他们因出售一批属于苏维埃国家贸易辛迪加（Gostorg）的珠宝而于1932年7月30日抵达上海。在此期间，他们居住在格罗西路（Route Grouchy）9弄16号 A. 比尔布雷耶的住所，根据我方情报，他们未能达成任何交易。

D. S.

特别处主管警官。
